verdict.rationale: The evidence documents physical and virtual corporate cards that ship worldwide. It never states that card spending abroad avoids foreign transaction fees, and it never mentions ATM cash withdrawals. The no-fee and competitive-FX claims cover cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts, not card spend, so they do not carry over to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can spend and withdraw cash abroad on a company card without hidden foreign fees
